stories.title: Fflint Wrecsam MS Ken Skates named Welsh Labour leader
stories.summary: Ken Skates MS has been confirmed as permanent leader of Welsh Labour. He received unanimous backing from all nine members of the Senedd Labour group. Skates represents Fflint Wrecsam, the Senedd constituency covering Flintshire and Wrexham. He became interim leader of Welsh Labour in May, after Eluned Morgan resigned. stories.title: Welsh Government loses first budget vote in Senedd defeat
stories.summary: The Welsh Government’s first supplementary budget has failed to pass in the Senedd, after a dispute over funding for additional learning needs left Plaid Cymru without the cross-party support it needed. stories.title: Unions react as Welsh Government confirms teachers’ pay rise below recommended 4.25%
stories.summary: Teaching unions have accused the Welsh Government of disregarding independent pay recommendations with strikes potentially looming in Flintshire and Wrexham. stories.title: Childline warns of summer spike in children seeking body image support
stories.summary: Childline is warning of a likely summer spike in children seeking support for body image concerns. New data from the NSPCC service shows it delivered 3,364 counselling sessions on body image and eating disorders between April 2025 and March 2026. stories.title: Flintshire Council seeks views on A548 Bagillt Road safety plan
